title: The Mouth
text: The ground opens like a mouth, slowly, lips of rock parting with a sound like a sigh. It breathes. Warm, wet air rolls out of it, smelling of meat. The way goes past its lip, and it is very wide, and you can see teeth.

options.label: Run past the lip while it breathes out, and pray it does not breathe in.

outcomes.text: Past, at a dead run, with its hot breath on your necks. Every heart is still pounding when the next fight comes.
It snaps, and the teeth close on legs.

options.label: Throw something in to feed it, and hope a full mouth is a kind one.

outcomes.text: It closes, slowly, satisfied, and the way beyond is shorter for it. Somewhere below, it chews.

options.label: The wisest leans over the teeth and looks down into it, to find where it leads.

outcomes.text: Down there, past the teeth, is the way out.
Down there, nothing. Nothing at all, and it looks back.
